hook: Fowler ran technology for one of America's largest industrial conglomerates, GE, where he oversaw a $3 billion budget and 25,000 employees and drove the insourcing of thousands of technology jobs, before leading Nationwide's digital transformation and now shaping Lumen's AI-driven network strategy as its CTPO.
name: Jim Fowler

quote.text: Businesses rarely understand the problems they have until you show them a better way. Whether it's through the use of technology or just good old business analysis, it is the job of the CTO to share a vision of what's possible.
quote.context: Jim Fowler, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief Technology and Product Officer at Lumen Technologies

timeline.event: Joins Accenture as a Manager on ERP implementation programs
Joins GE Infrastructure as CTO of Architecture & Design
timeline.impact: Begins a decade-plus career across GE's technology organization

timeline.event: Named Group CIO of General Electric
timeline.impact: Leads global technology strategy for the entire company

timeline.event: Joins Nationwide as Chief Technology Officer
timeline.impact: Leads digital product transformation for over seven years

timeline.event: Named Chief Technology and Product Officer, Lumen Technologies
timeline.impact: Leads technology, product, and AI-driven network strategy

quick_facts: Chief Technology and Product Officer at Lumen Technologies, leading technology, engineering, security, and product
Previously Group CIO of General Electric, managing a $3B+ annual budget and 25,000 employees
Led Nationwide's digital transformation as Chief Technology Officer for over seven years
Master's in Business Administration from Xavier University; Six Sigma Blackbelt

achievements.title: Named Chief Technology and Product Officer, Lumen Technologies (2026)
achievements.impact: Leads technology, engineering, security, and product organizations, overseeing Lumen's digital transformation and AI-driven vision as 'the trusted network for the digital economy.'

achievements.title: Group Chief Information Officer, General Electric (2015-2018)
achievements.impact: Led global technology strategy and a 25,000-person organization on a $3B+ annual budget; drove a Digital Thread transformation program targeting $1 billion in productivity, and led an insourcing initiative that added 2,000 GE technology employees while eliminating over 6,000 contractors.

achievements.title: Chief Information Officer, GE Capital
achievements.impact: Led technology for GE Capital's $350 billion asset portfolio, directing a multi-year modernization program to meet Dodd-Frank regulatory requirements.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, Nationwide (2018-2025)
achievements.impact: Led Nationwide's digital product transformation and operational efficiency automation strategy for over seven years.
